# MANGA MILLION fixtures

`series-page.html`, `captured-title.json`, and `captured-chapters.json` contain English One Piece metadata and ten catalog entries. The captured page reported 108 / 112 chapters; these files contain a sample of that catalog.

`contract.json` contains title, chapter-list, and viewer data. Browser mocks encode the captured fields as Protobuf and provide synthetic device tokens and encrypted image bytes. The additional language and unavailable-chapter scenario is synthetic.
